name: Image OSINT
summary: Extracts EXIF metadata and GPS location from photos, parsed locally without uploading them.
description:
For turning photos an analyst already holds into leads: the camera that took them, when, and where, where the file still says so. The body serial number ties photos to one physical camera. The image itself is not stored in the graph, only the fields read from it.

**Read results with care:**

- EXIF and GPS are read from JPEG files only, so a File node with no camera fields may be a non-JPEG image rather than a photo stripped of its metadata.
- `taken_at` is the original capture time when the file records one, otherwise its general DateTime tag; no time zone is read.
- A GPS block with no hemisphere reference is treated as empty: no Location node is added, rather than one at 0, 0.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-image-osint (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: EXIF Extract
plugins.description: Reads photos picked in the Run dialog (no selection), locally without uploading them. Creates a File node per photo with its SHA-256 and, for JPEGs, EXIF fields (camera make/model, body serial, lens, capture time, software), plus a Location node linked "captured at" when the photo has GPS coordinates.

images.title: Image files
images.description: One or more image files; EXIF and GPS are read from JPEGs only.
